    Returns & Remakes

    If It's On Us,
    We Fix It

    • Free

      Our Mistake

      Wrong name, number, colour or a production fault? We remake the pieces free and cover shipping both ways.

    • Free

      Size Sets

      The try-on size set we send before production is free and goes back with the prepaid label inside.

    • Free

      Damaged In Transit

      Send us photos within 14 days of delivery and we replace anything damaged on the way — no questions asked.

    • Not returnable

      Custom Kits

      Personalised items are made just for your club, so changes of mind can't be returned. That's why you approve the mockup and size set first.

    1. Tell us

      Email us within 14 days of delivery with your order number and what's wrong.

    2. Send photos

      A few photos of the affected pieces are enough — no need to send anything back yet.

    3. We fix it

      We confirm within one working day and ship the remade pieces as a priority.

    Shipping Questions

    Can I track my order?

    Yes. You get a tracking link by email as soon as your kits leave the factory, plus a production update when printing starts.

    Can you ship to several addresses?

    Yes — for example one box per team or straight to individual coaches. Each extra address is charged at the standard rate for that country.

    What if we need the kits faster?

    Choose express production (8 working days) when you approve your design. For really tight deadlines, call us — we'll tell you honestly what's possible.

    Do you ship outside the EU?

    We regularly ship to Switzerland and can quote other countries on request. Duties are always included in the quote, so there are no surprises at delivery.
